summary: Three days of old town, paella by the sea and a night at Mestalla.

items.title: Ciutat Vella walking loop
items.description: Cathedral, Miguelete tower, La Lonja de la Seda and the Central Market.

items.title: Horchata & fartons at Santa Catalina
items.description: Classic tiger-nut drink with sweet pastry sticks, a Valencian staple.

items.title: Paella valenciana lunch
items.description: Traditional chicken-and-rabbit paella; book ahead, paella is a lunch dish here.

items.title: Sunset at Malvarrosa beach
items.description: Flexible: walk the promenade back towards the port.

items.title: City of Arts and Sciences
items.description: Calatrava's futuristic complex; the Oceanogràfic needs a timed ticket.
items.location: Ciutat de les Arts i les Ciències

items.title: Tapas at Mercado de Colón
items.description: Modernista market hall with several tapas counters.

items.title: Pre-match drinks near Mestalla
items.description: Bars on Avinguda de Suècia fill up with fans two hours before kick-off.

items.title: Valencia CF home match (La Liga)
items.description: Kick-off time TBC by the league; check the club site the week before.

items.title: Bike the Turia gardens
items.description: 9 km park in the old riverbed, from Bioparc to the City of Arts and Sciences.

items.title: Lunch in El Palmar
items.description: Village in the Albufera rice fields, the birthplace of paella. Try arròs negre.

items.title: Albufera boat ride
items.description: Traditional flat-bottomed boat on the lagoon.

sights: Climb the Miguelete tower for the best old-town view
food: Try: paella valenciana, horchata with fartons, arròs negre
football: Valencia CF home match on Saturday; kick-off time not yet confirmed

warnings: Opening hours not verified for Sunday
